Definition: feminine from G2095 and the alternate of G2203 (as the god of the weather); a clear sky, i.e. fine weather:--fair weather.
BiblicalUsage: The word eudía carries the sense of fair weather. In Matthew 16:2, the text says "It will be] fair weather."
TheologicalSignificance: In eudía I find no hidden theology; it simply means fair weather.
RelatedTopics: Nature and Creation; Goodness of Creation; Provision
